notes: Local warm microbenchmarks; unrelated desktop activity was not reserved or excluded. No cross-machine or downstream performance claim.
The probe uses the same cases, fixtures and timed operations now preserved in benches/recovery_paths.rs. Allocation bytes are cumulative requested sizes, not peak or retained memory.

Decode and stream code is unchanged from the measured candidate to retained_runtime_revision. NEON dispatch was narrowed after the measurements to 10+4, shards at least 1 MiB, and 2-4 jobs; its generated kernel and job execution are unchanged.
Earlier broad NEON eligibility and automatic-budget trials are retained here as rejected exploration, not as measurements of final dispatch at those unsupported cases.

Only final-fixed-four rows passing both drift gates are used for recovery/stream latency observations. Only the long-encode 10+4/1MiB row passing both gates is used for the retained NEON latency observation.
All intermediate/rejected observations remain visible to avoid selecting only favorable samples.
